segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the rollout plan for the 38 seats and make sure procurement has what they need before the May 15 go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep. We’re still at 38 seats for launch. There may be another 6 from the support team in Q3, but I don’t want those on the initial order.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. I have the quote set up as 38 annual seats at $72 per user per month, billed annually, so $32,832 before tax. The additional seats would just prorate if you add them later.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. On billing, can the invoice reference PO 45127 and split the line items between software and implementation? Finance asked for that.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, that’s fine. I’ll note the PO in the billing tool and have implementation as a separate $4,500 line item. Same invoice, just two lines.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. And contract term is June 1 through May 31 next year, correct? Even if we go live May 15?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. We’ll use May 15 for onboarding access, but the subscription term starts June 1. That gives your team the two-week setup window at no charge.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Works for me. Legal had one small comment on the data retention language, but they said your last redline was acceptable if you add the 30-day export period.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I saw that note. Deal desk approved the 30-day export language this morning, so I’ll send the updated order form and agreement by 2 p.m. Eastern.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. If I have that today, I can route for signature tomorrow and target invoice processing by Friday.
